items.body_raw: זֶה הַיֶּלֶד אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַע אֶת־הַקּוֹל
items.answer_raw: This is the boy who heard the voice.

items.body_raw: מִי יָלַד אֶת־אֵלֶּה
items.answer_raw: Who has borne these?

items.body_raw: בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים אֵת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֵת הָאָרֶץ
items.answer_raw: God created the heavens and the earth.

items.body_raw: לקח המלך את־החרב
items.answer_raw: The king took the sword.

items.body_raw: This (is) the bad boy who spilt the water upon the earth.
items.answer_raw: זֶה הַיֶּלֶד הָרַע אֲשֶׁר שָׁפַךְ אֶת־הַמַּיִם עַל־הָאָרֶץ

items.body_raw: שָׁמַע הָאָדָם אֶת־הַקּוֹל בַּגָּן
items.answer_raw: The man heard the voice in the garden.

items.body_raw: מָחָה יהוה אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה מֵאָדָם וְעַד בְּהֵמָה
items.answer_raw: Yahweh blotted out everything which he had made, man and beast.

items.body_raw: עָשָׂה אֱלֹהִים אֶת־הָאָדָם עָפָר מִן־הָאֲדָמָה
items.answer_raw: God made the man out of dust from the ground.

items.body_raw: נָתַן אֶת־הַחֶרֶב לַמֶּלֶךְ
items.answer_raw: He gave the sword to the king.

items.body_raw: God gave the woman to the man for wife.
items.answer_raw: נָתַן אֱלֹהִים אֶת־הָאִשָּׁה לָאִישׁ לְאִשָּׁה

items.body_raw: Who spilt the water upon the earth?
items.answer_raw: מִי שָׁפַךְ אֶת־הַמַּיִם עַל־הָאָרֶץ

items.body_raw: ראה המלך בחלום את־הפרות הטבות על־היאר
items.answer_raw: The king saw in a dream the goodly kine by the river.

items.body_raw: God remembers the just (pl.).
items.answer_raw: זָכַר אֱלֹהִים אֶת־הַצַּדִּיקִים

items.body_raw: The captain (prince) reviewed all the mighty-men of valour and all the people of war.
items.answer_raw: פָּקַד הַשַּׂר אֶת־כָּל־גִּבּוֹרֵי הַחַיִל וְאֶת־כָּל־עַם הַמִּלְחָמָה

items.body_raw: כָּתַב הַנָּבִיא אֶת־כָּל־הַדְּבָרִים בַּסֵּפֶר
items.answer_raw: The prophet wrote all the words in a book.

items.body_raw: נָשָׂא הַנָּבִיא הַזָּקֵן אֶת־נִבְלַת אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֶל־הַחֲמוֹר
items.answer_raw: The aged prophet lifted the corpse of the man of God on to the ass.

items.body_raw: The king saw the fat kine upon the bank (lip) of the river.
items.answer_raw: רָאָה הַמֶּלֶךְ אֶת־הַפָּרוֹת הַבְּרִיאוֹת עַל־שְׂפַת הַיְאֹר

items.body_raw: He destroyed all the fishes of the river.
items.answer_raw: מָחָה אֶת־כָּל־דְּגַת הַיְאֹר

items.body_raw: זָכַר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת אֶת־אַבְרָהָם
items.answer_raw: He has remembered for ever his covenant, which he made with Abraham.

items.body_raw: שמע יהוה אלהינו את־תפלתנו
items.answer_raw: Yahweh our God has heard our prayer.

items.body_raw: God has redeemed his holy (ones).
items.answer_raw: פָּדָה אֱלֹהִים אֶת־קְדוֹשָׁיו

items.body_raw: He lifted his corpse upon the ass.
items.answer_raw: נָשָׂא אֶת־נִבְלָתוֹ אֶל־הַחֲמוֹר
